answer_1.quote: Abstractive conversation summarization, which condenses unstructured conversations into short, concise, and structured text... We evaluate on SAMSum, DialogSum and also test transferability on CNN/Dailymail.

answer_2.quote: We use the standard ROUGE metric as automatic evaluation metrics, including ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L for both SAMSum and DialogSum datasets.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluations to assess the summaries generated by different models ... annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk to rank summaries on a scale of 1 (the least preferred) to 3 (the most preferred).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank each summary on a 1‑3 scale indicating their preference.
